description: Saskatoon Transit updates safety plan, explores bear spray bylaw.
Transit researches real-time text reporting for riders.

chips.text: Councillor DeWaal questioned transit app safety survey results.
Youth involved in bear spray incidents on buses.
No statistics available on text reporting program effectiveness.
Bus Riders of Saskatoon urged faster implementation of safety measures.
City has limited jurisdiction to regulate bear spray.
Administration committed to June report on bear spray bylaw.

segments.title: Saskatoon Transit Frontline Employee Safety Plan Update
segments.takeaway: Administration presented an update on the safety plan, detailing initiatives like increased uniform presence, the community support team, and de-escalation training.

segments.title: Public comments on employee and rider safety
segments.takeaway: A public speaker raised concerns about delays in implementing safety measures and urged the exploration of additional actions for both rider and employee safety.

segments.title: Questions on real-time reporting and program metrics
segments.takeaway: Committee members questioned the administration about the timeline and feasibility of a real-time texting program for safety issues and the metrics used for evaluation.

segments.title: Addressing bear spray incidents on transit
segments.takeaway: The committee discussed the recent increase in bear spray incidents, arrests made, and the administration's work with SPS on potential bylaw amendments.

segments.title: Evaluating safety plan effectiveness and future options
segments.takeaway: The committee discussed the timeline for evaluating the current safety plan's effectiveness and whether to consider more extreme measures like transit police in the future.

segments.title: Rider safety survey methodology and results
segments.takeaway: The committee questioned the methodology and perceived discrepancy in the rider safety survey results, comparing them to anecdotal community feedback.

segments.title: Real-time rider communication and on-bus surveillance
segments.takeaway: The committee inquired about implementing real-time text reporting for riders and confirmed the presence of on-bus video surveillance for post-incident investigations.

segments.title: Follow-up on safety measures implementation
segments.takeaway: The committee followed up on the urgency of the bear spray report, delays in CCTV installation, the rider ban process, and advocacy for tougher sentences for assaults.

segments.title: Concluding remarks on safety plan update
segments.takeaway: The committee concluded the discussion on the safety plan update, with no further comments or recommendations before moving to the next agenda item.

description: Saskatoon Transit begins bus network redesign engagement in May 2025.

chips.text: Councillor requested historical ridership data beyond post-COVID figures.

All-day travel frequency supports shift workers, women, older adults, and equity-seeking groups.
Administration promised to report back to Council after each engagement phase.
